indicator.name: Equal-weight vs Cap-weight NASDAQ-100
indicator.description: Cumulative relative performance of the equal-weighted NASDAQ-100 (QQEW) versus the cap-weighted NASDAQ-100 (QQQ).
indicator.methodology: The ratio of QQEW (First Trust NASDAQ-100 Equal Weighted ETF) adjusted close to QQQ (Invesco QQQ, cap-weighted NASDAQ-100) adjusted close. Both series are normalized to 100 at their common start. Scoring uses the trailing 252-day relative return.
indicator.limitations: ETF-based proxy, not an official total-return index. QQEW began trading in 2006. The ratio reflects concentration in mega-caps but has other drivers.
